# Airbnb
> Airbnb is a global marketplace for short-term stays, vacation rentals, and travel experiences, with extensive guest and host support resources.

Airbnb helps guests book homes, rooms, and unique places to stay worldwide, while also providing tools for hosts to list properties, manage reservations, and understand policies, payments, and safety protections.

## Core Platform
- [Airbnb Home](https://www.airbnb.com/): Main entry point for searching stays, experiences, and travel planning worldwide.
- [Stays](https://www.airbnb.com/s/homes): Browse homes, apartments, cabins, and other places to stay.
- [Experiences](https://www.airbnb.com/experiences): Discover hosted activities and local experiences in destinations around the world.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.airbnb.com/giftcards): Buy and send Airbnb gift cards for travel purchases.
- [Airbnb Newsroom](https://news.airbnb.com/): Official company news, product announcements, and policy updates.

## Help Center
- [Help Center Home](https://www.airbnb.com/help): Central support hub for guests, hosts, accounts, payments, and policies.
- [Getting Started](https://www.airbnb.com/help/getting-started): Introductory help articles for using Airbnb and managing common tasks.
- [Guest Help](https://www.airbnb.com/help/topic/1418): Support resources for booking, staying, cancellations, and travel issues.
- [Host Help](https://www.airbnb.com/help/topic/1397): Support resources for listing, hosting, reservations, and payouts.
- [Account Help](https://www.airbnb.com/help/topic/1338): Articles about login, profile settings, verification, and account security.
- [Safety and Accessibility](https://www.airbnb.com/help/topic/1378): Guidance on safety, emergencies, accessibility, and responsible travel.

## Guest Policies and Booking
- [Booking a Stay](https://www.airbnb.com/help/topic/1418/booking): Help articles about searching, booking, and preparing for a trip.
- [Cancellations and Refunds](https://www.airbnb.com/help/topic/1418/cancellations): Information on cancellation policies, refunds, and reservation changes.
- [Payments for Guests](https://www.airbnb.com/help/topic/1418/payments): Guidance on payment methods, charges, and billing issues.
- [Check-in and Checkout](https://www.airbnb.com/help/topic/1418/check-in-checkout): Articles about arrival, departure, and accessing a place to stay.
- [Reviews for Guests](https://www.airbnb.com/help/topic/1418/reviews): Learn how reviews work for stays and guest-host interactions.

## Hosting
- [Become a Host](https://www.airbnb.com/host/homes): Start listing a home or room on Airbnb.
- [Host Resource Center](https://www.airbnb.com/resources/hosting-homes): Educational content, tips, and best practices for hosts.
- [Host Help](https://www.airbnb.com/help/topic/1397): Official support articles for hosting and listing management.
- [Responsible Hosting](https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/138): Overview of laws, rules, taxes, and hosting responsibilities.
- [AirCover for Hosts](https://www.airbnb.com/aircover-for-hosts): Protection information for hosts covering damage and liability support.
- [Community Center](https://community.withairbnb.com/): Discussion forums for hosts to share advice and ask questions.

## Safety, Protection, and Trust
- [AirCover for Guests](https://www.airbnb.com/aircover): Booking protection for guests including support for travel issues.
- [AirCover for Hosts](https://www.airbnb.com/aircover-for-hosts): Host protection details for damage coverage and liability insurance.
- [Safety Center](https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/1394): Safety guidance, emergency support, and travel security information.
- [Nondiscrimination Policy](https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/2867): Airbnb’s policy on inclusion, equal treatment, and discrimination prevention.
- [Accessibility Policy](https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/1869): Information about accessibility expectations and accommodation support.

## Account, Payments, and Gift Cards
- [Account Settings Help](https://www.airbnb.com/help/topic/1338): Manage login, profile details, verification, and account preferences.
- [Payment Methods](https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/126): Learn which payment methods Airbnb accepts in different regions.
- [Payout Methods](https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/425): Information for hosts on receiving payouts and setting payout preferences.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.airbnb.com/giftcards): Purchase Airbnb gift cards for personal gifting and travel use.
- [Gift Card Help](https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/981): Help with buying, redeeming, and using Airbnb gift cards.

## Policies and Legal
- [Terms of Service](https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/2908): Legal terms governing use of Airbnb’s platform and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/2855): Details on how Airbnb collects, uses, and protects personal data.
- [Payments Terms of Service](https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/2909): Terms covering payment processing and financial transactions on Airbnb.
- [Guest Refund Policy](https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/2868): Policy describing guest protections and refund eligibility.
- [Rebooking and Refund Policy](https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/2868): Rules for support when listings differ significantly from expectations.
- [Content Policy](https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/2673): Standards and rules for content shared on the Airbnb platform.

## Resources and Community
- [Host Resource Center](https://www.airbnb.com/resources/hosting-homes): Guides, articles, and practical advice for improving hosting operations.
- [Community Center](https://community.withairbnb.com/): Peer discussion space for hosts and community conversations.
- [Airbnb Newsroom](https://news.airbnb.com/): Official updates on company initiatives, travel trends, and announcements.
- [Airbnb Citizen](https://www.airbnbcitizen.com/): Public policy and community impact stories related to Airbnb.
- [Careers](https://careers.airbnb.com/): Information about jobs, teams, and working at Airbnb.
